about.title: About me
about.description_paragraph_1: I'm a frontend developer focused on building digital products that feel solid: fast, polished, and easy to use. I enjoy both resolving the visual details and ensuring a clean code architecture underneath.
about.description_paragraph_2: I have been working with design and product teams, taking interfaces from prototype to production, ensuring performance, accessibility, and consistency of the design system in each delivery.
about.description_paragraph_3: When I'm not coding, I'm reviewing design references, testing new tools, or fine-tuning this very site.

skills.title: Stack & tools
skills.description: Some of the technologies I work with.

freelance-part-time-web-developer.description: Web developer freelance part-time at 1Bit, focused on developing corporate websites and e-commerce stores with WordPress, WooCommerce and Webflow. Implementation of designs in Figma and customization of interfaces using Elementor and custom solutions. Setup of online stores, discounts, taxes and commercial features. Use of artificial intelligence tools to optimize development processes and automate tasks.

freelance-wordpress.description: Frontend development of corporate websites in WordPress, implementing Figma designs with pixel-perfect fidelity. Customization of themes and page builders, development and integration of custom plugins and setup of e-commerce stores.

zafirus.description: Frontend and backend development of web platforms in an agile team (Scrum). Focus on technical SEO, performance (WPO) and accessibility (WCAG 2.1, WAI-ARIA), with tracking of search engine positioning in Google Search Console. At Biobarica I implemented AMP to improve loading speed and SEO.

freelance-fullstack.description: Development and layout of interfaces, creation and integration of new modules and maintenance of online stores in Shopify and VTEX.

uces.description: Six years in charge of the development and evolution of the institutional website and the virtual campus for students. Both platforms were integrated with WordPress for content management (study plans, careers, news) and consumed a Laravel API connected to SQL Server, centralizing and synchronizing the information.
